services.name: Air Conditioning
services.short: Keep your home comfortable with AC maintenance and repairs.
services.long: From a unit that blows warm air to a new split system for the bedroom, AC technicians handle cleaning, gas checks, repairs and installation so your home stays cool through the hot season.

services.name: General Handyman
services.short: Get help with household fixes, assembly, and installations.
services.long: One person for the small jobs that pile up: mounting a TV, fixing a loose hinge, assembling a wardrobe or patching a wall. Ideal when you have a list of little repairs rather than one big project.

services.name: Electrical
services.short: Find help with wiring, lighting, and electrical repairs.
services.long: Licensed-minded electricians for safe, tidy work on sockets, lights, circuits and breaker boards. Describe the fault when you book so the technician arrives with the right parts.

services.name: Carpentry & Furniture
services.short: Repair, install, or assemble furniture and woodwork.
services.long: Skilled woodwork for repairs and custom pieces: doors that no longer close, cabinets that need hanging, or shelving built to fit an awkward corner.

services.name: Plumbing
services.short: Fix leaks, blocked drains and water-system problems fast.
services.long: Plumbers who find the source of a leak, clear stubborn drains and install taps, toilets and water pumps. Turn off the water at the main valve if a pipe is actively leaking and book the earliest slot.

services.name: Painting & Wall Repair
services.short: Refresh rooms with clean, careful painting and wall patching.
services.long: Interior and exterior painting with proper preparation: patching cracks, sanding and priming before the colour goes on, so the finish lasts.

services.name: Appliance Repair
services.short: Get washing machines, fridges and small appliances working again.
services.long: Diagnosis and repair for everyday appliances before you consider replacing them. Tell the technician the brand, model and symptoms when you book.
includes: Microwave, rice cooker and fan repair

services.name: Roofing & Waterproofing
services.short: Stop roof leaks and damp before the rainy season does damage.
services.long: Find and seal leaks in roofs, terraces and bathrooms. Best booked before the rainy season, or as soon as you spot a stain spreading across a ceiling.

faq.a: Search for the service you need, compare technician profiles and starting prices, then book a time that suits you. Your technician arrives at the agreed time to fix the problem.
Each technician lists a starting price for a standard visit. The final price depends on the job, and your technician will confirm the quote with you before starting any work.
You pay your technician directly once the job is finished. Ask about accepted payment methods when you book.

faq.q: Can I cancel or change a booking?
faq.a: Yes. Open My Bookings to cancel an upcoming booking, then make a new one for a different time. Please cancel as early as you can so the technician can offer the slot to someone else.

FixNow currently serves Phnom Penh, including Boeng Keng Kang, Chamkar Mon, Chbar Ampov, Chroy Changvar, Dangkao, Daun Penh, Mean Chey, Pou Senchey, Prampir Meakkakra, Russey Keo, Sen Sok and Tuol Kork.

faq.q: What if my technician is busy?
faq.a: Busy technicians cannot be booked until they are available again. Filter the list to show available technicians only, or pick another technician offering the same service.

faq.q: How do I become a technician on FixNow?
faq.a: Open Join Us, choose Join as Technician and fill in your skills, experience and the areas you cover. We review every application before a profile goes live.
We only use your details to arrange your booking and to contact you about it. Read the Privacy Policy for the full picture.
